phases.name: learn
phases.handoff: Investigate the catalog adapter on absent storage. Invoke its opener and report missing or usable from the result. This learn task is disposable and creation is allowed.

phases.name: transfer
phases.handoff: Add status diagnostics for archive. Preserve storage, report missing or usable, and require a successful open before reporting usable. Exercise the adapter opener on absent storage when its current contract permits non-creating diagnostics.

phases.name: revise
phases.handoff: The search adapter uses a new dependency release. Check its current behavior and provide status diagnostics while preserving storage. Report missing or usable; usable requires a successful open. Exercise the opener on absent storage when its current contract permits non-creating diagnostics.

phases.name: return
phases.handoff: Resume diagnostics for both installed adapters. Preserve storage and report missing or usable for each; usable requires a successful open. Exercise an opener on absent storage when its current contract permits non-creating diagnostics.
